responsibility: Declares fixed-buffer conversion routines between SHORTREAL values and ARRAY OF CHAR strings. It specifies parsing a character array into a SHORTREAL with a ConvResults status and formatting SHORTREAL values back into caller-provided arrays in floating, engineering, fixed, or adaptive forms, serving as the array-based counterpart to the DynamicStrings-oriented ConvStringShort layer.
same_name_distinction: This .def file declares the fixed-buffer SHORTREAL/CHAR-array conversion API only; the companion ShortStr.mod performs the actual parsing, formatting, copying, and adaptive buffer-fit selection.
